english.title: Water undertaker fail to provide water supply and pressure at fire service request re fire fighting
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a water undertaker to whom a fire and rescue authority, namely **(..SPECIFY AUTHORITY..), had made a request to provide a supply and pressure of water for the purposes of extinguishing a fire that was greater than the undertaker would otherwise provide, failed without reasonable excuse to take the necessary steps in order to do so in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 40(4) and (5) of the Fire and Rescue Services Act 2004.

english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), the defendant, being a water undertaker to whom a fire and rescue authority, namely **(..SPECIFY AUTHORITY..), had made a request to provide a supply and pressure of water for the purposes of extinguishing a fire that was greater than the undertaker would otherwise provide, failed without reasonable excuse to take the necessary steps in order to do so in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..).

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

Note
On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
